bullets.text: Chennai, Thiruvallur, and Chengalpattu face a heavy rainfall warning according to Sun News, and the office should monitor flood response preparations.
Pedestrians in Ambattur are forced onto busy roads due to blocked footpaths along the Avadi-CTH Road corridor, and the district team should inspect path clearances.
The Swaasa AI platform achieved ninety percent accuracy in detecting respiratory conditions from cough sounds, and the portfolio team should review potential healthcare applications.
Madurai MLA Thanga Pandian clarified that a woman arrested in a jewellery heist is not a TVK functionary, and the office should watch for further statements.
TVK MLA Thanga Pandian lodged a police complaint in Madurai over misleading social media posts regarding a theft case, and the office must track the investigation.

reports.title: TVK MLA complains over false posts linking theft suspect to TVK
